div.div:
OrderService
[Component: @Service · @Transactional]
createOrder() · confirmOrder() · cancelOrder()
findByUser() · findByOrderNumber()
Purchase orchestration:
• Fraud rate-limit (5 pending/10min)
• Event & sales validation
• Atomic ticket reservation
• Seat duplicate check
• Promotion application
• Total calculation with discounts

div.div:
StubPaymentService
[Component: implements PaymentService]
processPayment() · processRefund()
Mock payment gateway.
Generates "STUB-" + UUID tx IDs.
On success calls OrderService.confirmOrder()
Manages Payment lifecycle:
PENDING → COMPLETED → REFUNDED

TicketService
[Component: @Service · @Transactional]
issueTickets() · findByUser()
findByTicketCode() · validateTicket()

Ticket lifecycle: VALID → USED.
Entry-gate prevents re-use.

Validates date, active, max-uses.
Atomic currentUses increment.
